findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: three links with the accessible name 'View' (to /document/claude-haiku-5-5-system-card, …sonnet…, …opus…). In a links list they read 'View, View, View'. The row label 'System Card' is not part of the link name.
findings.after: View (or include visually hidden text)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) is borderline; 2.4.9 (AAA) fails. Same pattern as the sweep's 'Read announcement' repeat, but a different link set.

findings.evidence: Buttons named 'Related to Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5' etc. show only '···' visually. Voice-control users cannot guess the spoken name from the visible dots.
findings.after: Show a visible word ('Related') inside the button so the visible label is part of the accessible name
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.5.3 Label in Name (the visible label carries no words to match).

findings.evidence: focus.json / sweep: the skip link is first but reported covered by the sticky header when focused. Verified it is the first focus stop; covering confirmed by the sweep flag only.
findings.before: Skip link under the sticky header
findings.after: .skip-link:focus { position: fixed; top: 8px; left: 8px; z-index: (header z-index + 1) }

strengths: Skip link first; main, nav and footer present; lang and title set.
Carousel has a named 'Pause animation' button and named 'Previous slide' / 'Next slide' controls.
Icon-only controls have names: 'Search', 'Open menu', 'Anthropic home'.
Large linked cards carry full names ('The Anthropic Institute Our effort to confront…').
not_investigated: Image alt values are not recorded in the DOM capture; card images sit inside links that already have full text names, so alt="" would be correct. Sweep img_alt reported no misses.
Live keyboard check of the header dropdowns and footer accordions
disputed: sweep A11-007 'heading jumps from h1 to h3' on the announcement cards is real but minor; a hidden h2 ('2026 Public Benefit Report') sits in the carousel
